worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.summary: Piles every thought onto one foe in front: a scheme coils overhead and Special Attack rises sharply. The only member of its group that raises Sp. Atk alone, and the only one that needs a target to work at all; turn off Targeting a living foe to scheme behind closed doors for +1 instead. The stages come back when the window ends.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.use.0: Mark one foe before the fight and push Sp. Atk as high as it goes
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.use.1: Start the scheme before the foe can hide, or wait for the next meeting
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.use.2: With Targeting off, lay a scheme while travelling
Nasty Plot raises Special Attack by %1$s stages.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.wary.on: Targeting a living foe: Sp. Atk +2 and a longer scheme, but the scheme only works with a non-friendly living body in front of you.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.wary.off: Behind closed doors: Sp. Atk +1, usable at any time (even before a fight) with a shorter cooldown; strong-but-restricted against weak-but-always, each has its moment.
The scheme reaches %1$s blocks and lasts about %2$s; when the window ends or is cleared, the Sp. Atk stages this scheme raised are taken back. You hold position while casting.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.growth.0: At level %1$s the scheme lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.growth.1: At level %1$s the scheme reaches %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.preference.w: On: target a living foe, Sp. Atk +2 and a longer scheme, but only with a non-friendly living body in front of you. Off: scheme behind closed doors, Sp. Atk +1, usable at any time with a shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.preference.a: Consider a scheme when a threat is within this distance; larger starts earlier.
A threat closer than this makes the companion fight instead of scheming; larger gives up setup more often up close.
